newsitem.title: USA: Republic to fight Toyota complaint.
newsitem.headline: Republic to fight Toyota complaint.

text.p: Republic Industries Inc said Monday it will fight a lawsuit filed by Toyota Motor Corp's U.S. sales unit contesting its acquisition of two Florida Lexus dealerships.
In a written statement, Republic said the lawsuit is "frivolous and patently false."

Republic said it " easily meets" standards set under Florida state franchise law, which say a manufacturer can only contest a transfer of a franchise if the new owner lacks good moral character or sufficient business experience.
It said it has already entered into global agreements with other manufacturers.
Toyota's Toyota Motor Sales filed a complaint in Florida seeking to block Republic from acquiring the two dealerships owned by Gulf Management Inc.
Toyota alleged Republic has failed to comply with its established franchise requirements and policies.
Republic Industries is a holding company which operates under AutoNation USA and owns National Car Rental System Inc, Alamo Rent-A-Car Inc and Spirit Rent-A-Car Inc, as well as other businesses.
